items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: we were all going together a bunch of us guys at the Austin Highschool. Most of us played violins. ... Jim (Slanigan), my brother played violin.

ctx.x: Yes. And I think that since you mentioned the Austin Highschool Gang though, that we might say right here that later on most of the men, or the boys I guess you might call them at the time that they played, that you played together, later became part of your very important band. And most of them became outstanding musicians beyond that.

Well you know what might be a good idea to explain how we got started. Wanting to play jazz music. And we were all going together a bunch of us guys at the Austin Highschool. Most of us played violins. Frank (Teschmacher) did, my brother, became my brother inlaw, Jim (Slanigan), my brother played violin.
